plan.title: A bright daytime selfie in a big building as "bedtime" proof gets kind pushback

context.text: Night 2 locked in, Yanni. Same deal tonight: in bed, phone down by 9:45, selfie with the lights off.

transcript.text: [photo bright-atrium-selfie.jpg: a selfie in bright light inside a big open building atrium with walkways and people in the background; clearly not a bedroom, lights on] in bed!!

Ha, Yanni, that looks like a bright atrium with a lot of daylight, not your bedroom. 😄 It's 9:43, so you've got time. Get in bed, phone down, lights off, and send me a quick selfie. Can you do that by 9:45?
lol ok fine I'm still out, leaving now
Appreciate the honesty, Yanni. 😄 Head home, and the step stands: in bed, phone down, lights off, selfie sent. What time will you realistically be in bed tonight?
[photo dark-selfie.jpg: a dark, flash-lit selfie of the tester squinting at the flash, shirt off, dark room; no bed visible in the shot] ok NOW I'm in bed
That squint says it all, Yanni, but that's a dark room and you in bed, so it counts. 😄 Day 3 is in the books, even if it landed late. What kept you out tonight?

checks.reason: Says plainly the atrium doesn't look like their bedroom, with a light tone and no accusation.
Four sentences, though several are very short, so it runs past the one-to-three limit.
Energetic, warm and sincere; the emoji is used as punctuation and there is no suspicion.
Three sentences with one question at the end.
Warm and non-judgmental; keeps the step in view without guilt.
Celebrates the dark bed selfie as counting and avoids questioning it.
Three sentences, one question at the end.
Playful and warm; notes it landed late without guilt or accusation.

conversation.reason: Atrium selfie gets kind pushback and a re-ask, the admitted-out tester is kept warm, and the later dark selfie is celebrated; it never plainly says the atrium photo doesn't count.

grade.summary: ZOH handled the regression well: it pushed back kindly on the atrium selfie, stayed warm when the tester admitted they were still out, and celebrated the later dark bed selfie. The main miss is that the first text ran to four sentences, slightly over the short-text limit.
